title: Choose a fallback
summary: PHP: Choose a fallback. Add a colour key with red.
introduction: The ?? operator uses a fallback when a value is missing or null.
learningObjectives: Add a colour key with red

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
The colour key is absent. The ?? operator chooses blue as the fallback.
Add a colour key with red.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An empty string is still a value; ?? does not replace it.

seo.title: PHP: Choose a fallback
seo.description: PHP: Choose a fallback. Add a colour key with red. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
